title: Recruitment & Trials
summary: Adds a dashboard-first recruitment pipeline with Discord application tickets, automatic recruiter ownership, canned responses, interview scheduling, structured trials, private dashboard voting, applicant status tracking and final promotion into the existing Membership system.

sections.title: Applications & recruiter workflow
items: Apply to the Guild in the Welcome panel can now launch a native two-part BOM application with verification, a private ticket and a pinned applicant status panel.
The first configured recruiter who sends a normal message in an unassigned ticket automatically claims the application; dashboard transfers move ownership without allowing later replies to steal it.
Recruiters get dashboard assignment, status, interview, notes, canned responses and decision tools while Discord stays focused on the actual conversation.
Applicants always see their current stage, assigned recruiter, who the process is waiting on, what happens next and a visible application progress timeline.

sections.title: Trials & final review
items: Applications can advance into configurable timed trials with the Trial Discord role, midpoint check-ins, staff feedback and contextual participation summaries from Port Battles and Sentinel activity.
At trial end the assigned recruiter submits a recommendation before leadership voting opens; running vote totals remain hidden from ordinary voters.
Leadership can accept, extend or decline from the dashboard. Extending a trial resets the previous recommendation and vote round so the next review is independent.
Final acceptance assigns the configured BOM Member role, removes Applicant/Trial roles, updates the Guild Roster profile and lets existing Guild Prefix and Role Connections automation take over.

sections.title: Reliability & applicant experience
items: Application drafts can be resumed after Discord is closed and abandoned drafts expire automatically after 24 hours.
Configurable reminders cover unclaimed applications, applicant-required actions, midpoint reviews and overdue final recruiter recommendations; zero disables the applicable reminder.
Meaningful state changes are written to the recruitment timeline, reflected in the pinned status panel and sent to the applicant when appropriate.
Recruitment installs disabled by default so administrators can configure the ticket category, recruiter roles, Applicant/Trial/Member roles and voting roles before opening applications.
